hebrew:
הֲשִׁיבֵנוּ יְהוָה אֵלֶיךָ

וְנָשׁוּבָה

חַדֵּשׁ יָמֵינוּ כְּקֶדֶם
translation:
Return us, God, to you

and we will return;

renew our days [so that they are] as [they were] earlier [in times past]
